meta.source: 120 s holiday film, 2025 department-store Christmas campaign (brand removed: {BRAND})
meta.genre: family drama told without dialogue after 17 s, carried by one famous song cover

acts.name: Distance
acts.function: Christmas morning in a warm family house; the teenage son is shut away in over-ear headphones; mum and sister bustle; dad, kneeling at the tree, finds a flat red gift with a yellow note 'DAD'. Dialogue only here (mum, off-hand), then room tone.

acts.name: The gift
acts.function: Dad tears the paper: a vinyl record. He lowers the needle; the song's soft piano/vocal intro starts at 30.6 s. The son hears it from the stairs. Dad starts to nod.

acts.name: The memory
acts.function: Hard cut to a dark blue club: dad, same clothes, dances among young people (dance version of the song, loudest part, -10 LUFS). The crowd falls away (top-down), dad alone in one warm spotlight; then his son at every age in the dark: teen, toddler, baby in his arms. Shots fade to and from black (0.4-1.1 s blacks).

acts.name: Together
acts.function: Back home at the shelf, eyes wet. The son comes down the stairs, headphones round his neck now, and walks to him; the hug; the son smiles; both laugh.

acts.name: End card
acts.function: Soft-focus wide of the living room with the tree; two thin white supers, then the {BRAND} wordmark.

music_arc.what: No score: room tone of a busy house, paper rustle (loudest 23.5-26.3 as the paper tears), mum's off-hand lines 0.3-8.1 and 11.7-17.3 (about -25 to -40 LUFS).
Needle drop: click at 29.1, then vinyl crackle.
The song (a famous 1990s house track, here as a slow, intimate female-vocal cover) enters soft: piano chords and voice, -20 to -15 LUFS, 123 bpm grid (bars every 1.951 s from 30.616).

Hard switch on the picture cut into the club: full dance arrangement, four-on-the-floor kick, loudest part of the film (-10 to -12 LUFS); vocal 'Why don't you take my hand, come away' 57.1-62.5. Bars every 1.95 s from 42.398.
Arrangement thins and fades with the crowd: pads and kick decay to -25/-31 LUFS through the memory blacks.

Slow ballad cover returns (~105.5 bpm, bars every 2.275 s from 83.052; ~106.5 bpm, bars every 2.254 s from 101.01): 'Why don't you take my hand... come out of the blue' over the baby and the return home; chorus 'deep down where the love lives' over the hug and laugh (-15 to -25 LUFS).
Outro: last 'where the love lives' ends 116.5, a sustained piano chord rings out under the wordmark, -27 to -45 LUFS.

sound.speech: On-camera speech only in the first 17 s (mum, off-hand, not kept in either cut). Everything else is the song's vocal (sung lyric, in the score).
sound.mix: Music is the whole soundtrack after the needle drop; no sound effects over the club or memory; in the home scenes after 30 s the music sits alone (no dialogue, no foley except the hug). The score cut files carry everything.

look.grade: Warm naturalistic film grade at home: amber-cream walls, olive green, teal-blue knit and red paper as the only saturated colours; skin warm. The club is its own grade: deep blue-teal (#0c1724), crushed blacks, cyan and green accents. The memory void is black with one warm key.
look.contrast: Soft at home (lifted blacks, no clipped whites except windows); hard in the club and the memory (true black around a lit subject).
look.light: Home: soft overcast daylight through large windows plus warm practicals (fairy lights, lamps, candles). Club: coloured top light and edge light, no fill. Memory: single warm overhead spotlight or soft warm key from the left, everything else black.
look.depth_of_field: Shallow throughout (long lens feel, 50-85 mm): backgrounds melt to bokeh of fairy lights; inserts and close-ups have 2-10 cm of focus. The end card is entirely out of focus.
look.grain: Fine 35 mm-like grain, slight halation on practicals.
look.brightness: Measured 0-255: home daylight shots sit at 90-140 (son by the window 107-137, stairs/hallway 100-117), home evening/shelf shots at 55-95 (gift insert 52, unwrap 57-63, sleeve 68-83, turntable 76-80, shelf 75-93), the club at 25-40, the crowd-to-black and memory shots at 0-35 (spotlight floor 7-21, baby 12-35), the end card at 80-95.
look.camera: Mostly handheld-steady or slow dolly; no whips, no zooms. Inserts on hands and the gift. Low angles on dad with the record; top-down for the spotlight.

text_style.typeface: Thin humanist sans-serif (light weight), all capitals, very wide tracking (about +200 for the supers, about +400 for the wordmark).
text_style.supers: Centred at 50% x, 50% y; cap height 3.7% of frame height; 'FIND THE GIFT' spans 27% of frame width (36.6%-63.5%). One line each, two supers in sequence, 0.4 s dissolve in and out, crossfading into each other.
text_style.wordmark: {BRAND} wordmark centred at 50% x, 50% y; cap height 8.3% of frame height; spans 60% of frame width (20%-80%); same thin sans, widest tracking; 0.5 s dissolve in, holds to the end, no fade out.
text_style.elsewhere: No other on-screen text; the only in-picture writing is the hand-drawn 'DAD' note and the sleeve title.

char_father.fixes: The father, an invented man about 48: medium build, light olive skin, dark-brown curly tousled hair greying at the temples, salt-and-pepper stubble; dark olive-green overshirt worn open over a heather-grey tee, indigo jeans, brown boots, gold wedding band. Same outfit at home and in the club memory.

char_son.fixes: The son, an invented boy about 17: slim, fair, dark-brown shaggy hair with a fringe; teal-blue (#1d5f86) fluffy mohair sweater, white tee hem, black trousers; matte navy over-ear headphones with no logo (on his ears in act 1, round his neck from S15).

char_baby.fixes: The son as a baby (memory, S36): about 6 months, wispy light-brown hair, laughing, in a teal-blue knit romper (the same blue as the teen's sweater: the colour that links the ages).

product_gift_record.fixes: The gift: flat square 31 cm parcel in glossy red (#c0141c) paper with darker red (#8a0f14) tree print, yellow (#f2e45a) sticky note 'DAD' + smiley in black marker; inside, a sleeve with a blurred club-light photo grading magenta-purple (#7a2a8c) to red (#d2302a) to orange-gold (#f0902a), white bold condensed title 'DEEP DOWN' lower left; black vinyl, plain cream label.

product_turntable.fixes: Record player on the shelf: matte white plinth, brushed silver platter with polished rim, black mat, slim straight silver tonearm, black headshell, cueing lever back right.

loc_living_room.fixes: Living room: tall lit fir tree, tan leather sofa, patterned rug with torn paper, tall window with sheer curtains, bookshelves wrapped in fairy lights, globe pendant. Daylight + warm practicals, brightness 70-110.

loc_window_desk.fixes: Sitting-room corner where the son sits: table by a tall black-framed window, overcast daylight, arc floor lamp, fiddle-leaf fig, white walls. Brightness 100-140.

loc_record_corner.fixes: Dad's record shelf: white built-in shelves with vinyl, black speakers, the white turntable, framed photos, fairy lights, candles. Evening-warm, brightness 60-95.

loc_hallway_stairs.fixes: Hallway: white staircase, handrail wrapped in pine garland with tiny warm lights, cream walls, orange-sun print, paper star lantern. Daylight, brightness 90-117.

loc_club_floor.fixes: Memory club: black room, blue-cyan top lights, green beams, dark reflective floor. Brightness 25-40, its own blue grade.

loc_club_spotlight.fixes: Memory void: worn dark wooden dance floor, one warm overhead spotlight pool, pure black around. Brightness 5-21 (pool ~110).

score.fixes: The full soundtrack (room tone, needle drop, the song); cut versions set/score_30.wav and set/score_15.wav.
